wings.name: Miyamoto Musashi
wings.title: The Master
wings.hook: Swordsman, painter and writer of The Book of Five Rings.

wings.name: Marcus Aurelius
wings.title: The Steady Mind
wings.hook: The Roman emperor whose private notes became Meditations.

wings.name: Nikola Tesla
wings.title: The Inventor
wings.hook: The inventor known for his work on alternating current.

wings.name: Cleopatra VII
wings.title: The Scholar Queen
wings.hook: The last Ptolemaic ruler of Egypt, who spoke many languages and ruled for 21 years.

wings.name: Leonardo da Vinci
wings.title: The Curious Mind
wings.hook: The painter of the Mona Lisa who filled thousands of notebook pages with questions.

wings.name: Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj
wings.title: The Founder King
wings.hook: Founder of the Maratha state, builder of hill forts and a navy, crowned in 1674.

wings.name: Marie Skłodowska-Curie
wings.title: The Radium Pioneer
wings.hook: The scientist who discovered polonium and radium and won two Nobel Prizes.

wings.name: William Shakespeare
wings.title: The Playwright
wings.hook: The actor and part-owner of a theatre who wrote about 39 plays and 154 sonnets.

wings.name: Saladin
wings.title: The Just Sultan
wings.hook: The sultan who united Egypt and Syria, retook Jerusalem and made peace with Richard.

wings.name: Isaac Newton
wings.title: The Natural Philosopher
wings.hook: The farm boy who explained light, motion and gravity with experiments and maths.

wings.name: Benjamin Franklin
wings.title: The Self-Made Citizen
wings.hook: Printer, scientist and statesman who gave his inventions away.

wings.name: Katsushika Hokusai
wings.title: The Restless Painter
wings.hook: The Edo artist who drew all his life and said he was still learning.

wings.name: Abraham Lincoln
wings.title: The Self-Taught President
wings.hook: With under a year of school, he taught himself law and wrote words that held a nation.
